steps.name: Settle in
steps.say: Sit tall near the front of your chair, feet flat on the floor. Let's take two slow breaths together.

steps.name: Neck tilts
steps.say: Gently tilt your ear toward your right shoulder. Hold. Now slowly to the left. Nice and easy.

steps.name: Shoulder rolls
steps.say: Roll your shoulders up, back, and down. Five times. Now the other direction.

steps.name: Seated march
steps.say: Lift one knee, then the other, like a slow march. Hold the sides of the chair if you like.

steps.name: Check in
steps.say: We're halfway there. How are your shoulders feeling?

steps.name: Ankle circles
steps.say: Lift one foot a little and draw slow circles with your toes. Then switch feet.

steps.name: Seated side reach
steps.say: Raise your right arm and reach gently over to the left. Breathe. Now the other side.

steps.name: Cool down
steps.say: Rest your hands on your lap. Breathe in, and out. You did wonderful today.

steps.name: Settle in
steps.say: Sit tall near the front of your chair, feet flat on the floor. Let's begin.

steps.name: Seated leg lifts
steps.say: Straighten one leg out in front of you, hold a moment, then lower it slowly. Now the other leg.

steps.name: Arm presses
steps.say: Press your palms together in front of your chest and push gently. Feel your arms working.

steps.name: Check in
steps.say: We're halfway there. How are you feeling?

steps.name: Sit to stand
steps.say: If you're able, stand up slowly from your chair, then sit back down. Use the armrests for balance if you need to.

steps.name: Shoulder presses
steps.say: Raise both arms overhead, like you're reaching for the sky, then lower them slowly.

steps.name: Cool down
steps.say: Rest your hands in your lap. Take a deep breath in, and let it out. Well done today.

steps.name: Settle in
steps.say: Stand behind your chair, holding on with both hands for support.

steps.name: Weight shifts
steps.say: Slowly shift your weight to your right foot, then to your left. Nice and steady.

steps.name: Heel raises
steps.say: Rise up onto your toes, then lower back down. Hold the chair if you need to.

steps.name: Check in
steps.say: How's your balance feeling so far?

steps.name: Single leg stand
steps.say: Lift one foot just a little off the floor for a moment. Then switch sides.

steps.name: Cool down
steps.say: Sit back down and rest. You're building strength and confidence with every practice.

steps.name: Get ready
steps.say: Find a clear path, indoors or out, and wear comfortable shoes.

steps.name: Warm up
steps.say: Start with a slow, easy pace. Let your arms swing naturally.

steps.name: Steady pace
steps.say: Keep a comfortable, steady pace. Breathe easily as you walk.

steps.name: Check in
steps.say: How are you doing? Keep going at whatever pace feels right.

steps.name: Steady pace
steps.say: You're doing wonderfully. Keep that easy, steady pace.

steps.name: Cool down
steps.say: Slow your pace for this last stretch. Nice, easy steps.
